free_tier.stated: Conflicting. The live UGS pricing page lists Cloud Content Delivery 'Cloud Storage — Free'. A third-party writeup of the same product reports 5 GB/month included. Unresolved; treat as small until an account test settles it.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Per-object-cap: entry upload bounded by the storage allowance; request-rate: API requests currently unlimited/free; per-ip-shaping: none documented. Retention: releases are immutable snapshots, kept until deleted. Good archive semantics if the quota is real.

egress.terms: Metered after a free tier allowance: 'Bandwidth (CCD) 50 GB / month. After 50 GB: $0.08 per GB, After 50 TB: $0.06 per GB'.

tooling: UGS CLI (`ugs ccd ...`), Content Delivery Management API and Client API, plus the CCD Management SDK. Releases are content-addressed: entries carry an md5 content hash and size that must match on upload.
chaining: Buckets per environment x releases per bucket x promotion between buckets. Note: 'Creating or promoting a new release does not create copies of the entries in a bucket'. Promotion is a pointer, not a copy, so it does NOT multiply storage.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: entry upload bounded by the storage allowance; request-rate: API requests currently unlimited/free; per-ip-shaping: none documented. Retention: releases are immutable snapshots, kept until deleted. Good archive semantics if the quota is real.
reliability_note: The old CCD API-key auth and UCD CLI were deprecated in 2024 with no planned sunset after community pushback, so the write path still works but is on a deprecated auth path. Public read URLs are of the form https://{projectId}.client-api.unity3dusercontent.com/client_api/v1/buckets/{bucketId}/releases/{releaseId}/entry_by_path/content/?path=<path>.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.
